definitions.gloss: phone photo; phone snapshot; photo sent by phone
definitions.explanation: A photo taken with a mobile phone, especially a casual one shared with friends. Originally short for {写真|しゃしん}メール (photo message), the term still feels somewhat dated and is mostly used by older speakers.

examples.japanese: ランチの{写|しゃ}メを{撮|と}った。
examples.english: I took a phone photo of my lunch.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{孫|まご}の{様子|ようす}を{知|し}りたがるので、よく{写|しゃ}メを{送|おく}っている。
examples.english: My mother wants to know how her grandchild is doing, so I often send her phone photos.

notes:
Originally short for {写真|しゃしん}メール ("photo mail"), referring to the early-2000s practice of sending photos via cell-phone email. The word peaked around the flip-phone era and now sounds slightly dated — younger speakers are more likely to say {写真|しゃしん} or use service names like LINE で{送|おく}る.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写|しゃ}メを{撮|と}る: to take a phone photo
- {写|しゃ}メを{送|おく}る: to send a phone photo
- {写|しゃ}メる: (verb form) to snap a phone photo

REGISTER:
Casual only. Avoid in formal writing or business contexts, where {写真|しゃしん} or {画像|がぞう} is more appropriate.
